messages.cosmos.explore: Walk with [←] [→] or click the papyrus. Figures glow under the pointer; click one to read about it. The whole scroll is open to explore.
messages.procession.complete: The procession is in order. Head over to Ra on his throne.
messages.dangers.complete: Walk left to the end of the scroll.
messages.dangers.end: Spell 42 is a list, not a picture: each part of the body is given to a god.
messages.dangers.defeated: One bite too many: the spear-bearer crumbles to dust.
messages.dangers.retry: The fight is lost. Click the creature to take up the spear again.
messages.dangers.left_fight: You step back out of the vignette. Click the creature to take it up again.
messages.dangers.click_to_fight: Click the creature to take up the spear.
messages.dangers.heka_controls: Hold [shift] while striking to fight off the red crocodiles. Don't use heka on the regular crocodiles, or they'll make off with it!
messages.procession.start: The procession has stalled at the head of the scroll. Walk left (the scroll reads right to left) and see what is wrong.
messages.procession.kneel: The procession has arrived. Kneel before Ra as he sets.
messages.interaction.hands_full: You carry %s. Put it back where you took it to free your hands.
messages.dangers.start: The road to the hall of judgment begins here. Walk left, toward the crocodiles.
messages.dangers.blocked: The way on opens only once every danger up to the breath of life is overcome. Still to do: spell %s.
messages.dangers.unfinished: Spell 42 waits until every danger behind you is overcome. Still to do: spell %s.
messages.dangers.finished: The road is clear. You carry the breath of life.
messages.dangers.outro: The dangers are overcome. You carry [b]the breath of life[/b].
messages.cosmos.start: Walk left through the night world. Click a figure to look, or open the Journal to read what you have seen.

procession.haul.instructions: Can you help us haul the bier? Heave with [space] when my whip falls. Wait for my count, then pull on each beat.
procession.haul.success: Well hauled! The sledge stands where it should, and the mummy goes on toward the tomb.

feedback.left_haul: Speak with the ox-driver when you are ready to return.
feedback.missed_beat: Missed a beat. Heave as the whip falls.
feedback.off_beat: Too %s. Heave as the whip falls.

find.default: Walk left to the stalled bier. Speak with the ox-driver beside the ox.
find.right: Walk right to the stalled bier. Speak with the ox-driver beside the ox.

pull.text: Heave with [space] as the whip falls. Too early or late makes the bier slip back.

procession.standards.instructions: Can you help us? We carry each other's gods. Drag each standard to the bearer it belongs to.
procession.standards.success: All eight standards are in order.

feedback.empty_pole: Take a standard from another bearer first.

find.default: Click the group of eight standard-bearers to put their standards in order.

sort.text: The priest with two plumes reads the order. He stands beyond the offering table.
Jackal, ibis, falcon, bull, vulture, placenta, plumes, falcon: follow the procession from its front.

procession.offerings.instructions: Can you help restore the offering table? Drag items to their rightful place. I can help you if you get lost.
procession.offerings.success: The offering table is whole again.

feedback.missing_support: It needs support. Place the lower offerings first.
feedback.goose_on_table: The goose is not an offering for this table. Its bearer is beside the lector.

find.default: Click the collapsed offering table to begin rebuilding it.

build.text: Click the lector beside the table. He shows an offering you can place now.
Build lowest first. An offering falls if its support is missing.
Drag pieces above the upper shelf to clear space. They fall onto it; drag them back across to use them.

procession.goose.instructions: He hands you the loaf. It belongs on the offering table, and he is still missing his goose.
procession.goose.success: He takes his goose back in his arms, as it is drawn.

feedback.instructions_empty: His arms are empty. He carried a goose; it must be among the fallen offerings.
feedback.success_swapped: He takes his goose and hands you the loaf. It belongs on the offering table.
feedback.success_carrying: He carries his goose to the tomb.
feedback.holding_loaf: Odd that he's holding a loaf of bread.
feedback.offering_in_arms: He has no use for that. It belongs on the offering table.

find.default: The goose-bearer holds a loaf. Take it, then find his goose among the fallen offerings.
find.empty: His arms are empty. He carried a goose; it must be among the fallen offerings.

return.text: The goose-bearer holds a loaf. Take it, then find his goose among the fallen offerings.

find_goose.text: His arms are empty. He carried a goose; it must be among the fallen offerings.
Find his goose among the fallen offerings.

procession.water.instructions: Can you help me pour? My arm is tired and the jar droops. Hold [space] to lift it, and keep the water running along the line.
procession.water.success: The water arches over Anubis and the mummy and runs down to their base, as it is drawn.

feedback.pouring: The water runs along the line. Keep it there.
feedback.dripping: Too high: the jar only drips. Let it sink a little.
feedback.gushing: His arm droops too far: the water gushes out onto the woman's raised hands. Hold [space] to lift the jar.

find.default: Find the priest with a jar above a kneeling woman. Click him to pour the water.

pour.text: Too high only drips; drooped too far, the water splashes short. Keep the stream on its faint guide.
His arm droops faster or slower from moment to moment: watch it, and lift as it sinks.
Hold [space] to lift his drooping arm; let go to let it sink.

procession.bulls.success: The plumed ox lowers his head to the calf. All three are as they should be.

feedback.plumes_restored: The disc and plumes sit on the living ox again.
feedback.calf_turned: The calf turns its back on the block and settles.

find.default: Something is wrong with the bulls near the sacrifice. Click one of them.

calf.text: Look at which way each animal faces, and what each one wears.
The calf is facing the sacrifice. Drag it sideways to turn it away.

plumes.text: Look at which way each animal faces, and what each one wears.
The disc and plumes are on the bull at the block. Drag them onto the living ox's head.

procession.opening_mouth.instructions: Help me finish his face. Click with the adze tip within the faint eye and mouth. [esc] steps away.
procession.opening_mouth.success: The words stand over Ra again, as they are written.

feedback.success_opened: You touch the adze to the mummy's mouth. Its mouth opens, and words come out.
feedback.adze_taken: You take the adze from the low table: a hooked blade on a long handle.
feedback.left_carving: We can try his face again when you are ready.

find.default: Take the hooked adze beside the obelisks and touch the mummy's mouth.
find.adze: Touch the adze to the mummy that Anubis holds upright.
find.words: Carry the words above the mummy to Ra, at the far left.

carve.text: Click rather than drag; touch the adze tip within the faint eye and mouth to finish them. [esc] steps away.

words.text: Carry the words to their faint outline over Ra, at the far left.

procession.offering_stand.success: The stand stands before Ra again, the sun disc on it and the lotus bending over it.

feedback.instructions_stela: Something stood here before Ra. The stela by the tomb shows what.
feedback.success_stela: The stand stands before Ra again, the sun disc on it and the lotus bending over it, as on the stela.
feedback.unsupported: %s has nothing to rest on yet.
feedback.unsupported_stela: %s has nothing to rest on yet. Look at the stela: something stands beneath it.
feedback.not_ready_to_collect: This might come in handy later, but you wouldn't want your hands full right now.

find.default: The stela beside Ra shows the missing offering stand.

collect.text: The stela beside Ra shows the missing offering stand.
Look behind the women mourners, on the bier, and on the offering pile for its three pieces.

assemble.text: Place the stand before Ra, then the sun disc, then the lotus.

dangers.e31.instructions: Meet each snout with your spear tip. Strike as they touch. Three bites end the attempt.

feedback.controls_both: Press [space] to thrust the spear; [↑] [↓] (or [w] [s]) move you; [←] [→] turn you.
feedback.controls: Press [space] to thrust the spear; [↑] [↓] (or [w] [s]) move you.
feedback.first_crocodile: Here one comes. Meet its snout with the spear tip, and press [space] as they touch.
feedback.first_strike: Well struck. More are coming, at different heights.
feedback.heka_break: The crocodiles draw back. Above, signs begin to glow red.
feedback.heka_on_normal_crocodile: Heka spent on an ordinary crocodile! It seizes the word of power and makes off with it. The crocodiles are not turned back.
feedback.crocodile_escaped: A crocodile slipped past you to the wall. It laughs, and the word of heka falls to it.
feedback.red_crocodile: Bronze alone will not turn the red ones. The signs glowing above may tell you how.
feedback.tutorial_bite: The crocodile reached you. Line the spear tip up with its snout, and strike as they touch.
feedback.behind_you: One comes from behind! [←] [→] turn you to face either way.
feedback.movement_lesson: Good. Now move: [↑] [↓] (or [w] [s]) take you up and down.

find.default: Look for crocodiles of spell 31 to your left.
find.nearby: Click the creature to take up the spear.
find.right: Look for crocodiles of spell 31 to your right.

fight.text: Aim with [↑] [↓]. Press [space] when the snout meets the spear tip.

heka.text: Aim with [↑] [↓]. Press [space] when the snout meets the spear tip. Hold [shift] only for red crocodiles.

dangers.e32.instructions: Face the approaching crocodile and meet its snout with your spear. Use heka only against red ones.
dangers.e32.success: The crocodiles of the four quarters are turned back.

feedback.controls_both: Press [space] to thrust the spear; [↑] [↓] (or [w] [s]) move you; [←] [→] turn you.
feedback.controls: Press [space] to thrust the spear; [↑] [↓] (or [w] [s]) move you.
feedback.first_crocodile: Here one comes. Meet its snout with the spear tip, and press [space] as they touch.
feedback.first_strike: Well struck. More are coming, at different heights.
feedback.heka_break: The crocodiles draw back. Above, signs begin to glow red.
feedback.heka_on_normal_crocodile: Heka spent on an ordinary crocodile! It seizes the word of power and makes off with it. The crocodiles are not turned back.
feedback.crocodile_escaped: A crocodile slipped past you to the wall. It laughs, and the word of heka falls to it.
feedback.red_crocodile: Bronze alone will not turn the red ones. The signs glowing above may tell you how.
feedback.tutorial_bite: The crocodile reached you. Line the spear tip up with its snout, and strike as they touch.
feedback.behind_you: One comes from behind! [←] [→] turn you to face either way.
feedback.movement_lesson: Good. Now move: [↑] [↓] (or [w] [s]) take you up and down.

find.default: Look for crocodiles of spell 32 to your left.
find.nearby: Click the creature to take up the spear.
find.right: Look for crocodiles of spell 32 to your right.

fight.text: Turn with [←] [→], aim with [↑] [↓]. Hold [shift] only when striking a red crocodile.

heka.text: Turn with [←] [→], aim with [↑] [↓]. Hold [shift] only when striking a red crocodile. Hold [shift] only for red crocodiles.

dangers.e33.instructions: Watch its tail: it warns before the snake springs. Strike as its head reaches the spear point.

feedback.struck_more: Struck! It pulls free and coils again. %d more.
feedback.too_early: Too early: your spear was already coming back up when it sprang. Wait for the snap.
feedback.too_late: Too late: it was past the point of your spear.
feedback.bite_advice: It bit you. When its tail waves and it squashes down, it is about to spring: thrust as it springs.
feedback.controls: Press [space] to thrust the spear, just as the snake springs. You cannot step.

find.default: Look for the lunging snake to your left.
find.nearby: Click the creature to take up the spear.
find.right: Look for the lunging snake to your right.

fight.text: Wait for the tail to wave, then strike as the snake springs. Each hit makes the target smaller.

dangers.e35.instructions: Creep closer while its head is down. Stop when it lifts its head. Strike when your target dot reaches its eye.
dangers.e35.success: The snake on the ground lies still.

feedback.struck_more: Struck! It pulls free and slides off ahead of you. %d more.
feedback.bitten: %s Bitten. When its head lifts, let go of the keys and wait until it looks away again.
feedback.seen_moving: It turned and saw you move.
feedback.missed_eye: That hit its head, but not the eye. Bring the red dot onto its eye before you thrust.
feedback.out_of_reach: Short of its eye: the spear strikes the ground, and it hears.
feedback.controls: [←] (or [a]) creeps toward it; [space] thrusts. Hold still while it looks back.

find.default: Look for the snake on the ground to your left.
find.nearby: Click the creature to take up the spear.
find.right: Look for the snake on the ground to your right.

fight.text: Hold [←] only while it looks away. Stop when its head lifts. Aim the target dot at its eye.

dangers.e36.instructions: Spear all five beetles when they pause near the point. Turn to face them. Each can escape three times.

feedback.swarm: It slipped past one time too many. Apshai never travels alone.
feedback.controls: Press [space] to thrust the spear; [←] [→] turn you. You cannot step.

find.default: Look for the apshai beetle to your left.
find.nearby: Click the creature to take up the spear.
find.right: Look for the apshai beetle to your right.

fight.text: Turn toward a beetle when it pauses at the spear point. The redder it is, the fewer escapes it has left.

dangers.e37.instructions: Turn to the snake that strikes ([←] [→]), and thrust as it springs.

feedback.struck_partial: Struck! It pulls free and coils again.
feedback.provoked: It saw the spear and sprang. Wait for its sign to flash and for it to squash down; thrust as it springs.
feedback.wrong_direction: It sprang from your other side. Turn to face it ([←] [→]).
feedback.mistimed_thrust: Too early or too late: thrust just as it springs past your spear point.
feedback.bite_advice: It sprang at you. When it squashes down, thrust as it springs.
feedback.controls: [←] [→] (or [a] [d]) turn you; [space] thrusts. Thrust as a snake springs at you.

find.default: Look for the two merti snakes to your left.
find.nearby: Click the creature to take up the spear.
find.right: Look for the two merti snakes to your right.

fight.text: Watch the signs above. Striking too soon provokes a snake.

dangers.e38.instructions: He offers the ankh and sail: life and breath.
dangers.e38.success: You take the sail: the breath of life.

feedback.success_sail38: You take the sail: the breath of life.
feedback.success_ankh38: You take the ankh: life. The sail stays in his hand.

find.default: Look for the breath of life to your left.
find.right: Look for the breath of life to your right.

choose.text: Take one sign from his hand, the ankh or the sail. The caption above says which you need.

dangers.e39.instructions: Follow each wave from Apep’s tail. Strike as it reaches your spear point. Leave waves that fade away alone.
dangers.e39.success: Apep lies still, pinned at the neck.

feedback.barb_advanced: Pressed down: the barb goes in a step.
feedback.too_early: Too early: wait until the wave reaches your spear point.
feedback.barb_slipped: The barb jars on a still neck and works loose a step. Thrust only as a wave reaches the point.
feedback.no_wave: Nothing there to press down. Thrust only as a wave reaches the point.
feedback.missed_wave: Too early: your spear came and went before the wave reached it.
feedback.wave_passed: The wave lifted his head from under your spear. When it reaches the point, thrust.
feedback.controls: Press [space] to thrust the spear as a wave reaches its point. You cannot step.

find.default: Look for apep to your left.
find.nearby: Click the creature to take up the spear.
find.right: Look for apep to your right.

fight.text: Strike as a wave reaches the point. Small waves fade before reaching you; striking a still neck loosens the barb.

dangers.e40.instructions: Strike the snake three times without hitting the ass beneath it.
dangers.e40.success: The snake falls from the donkey's back.

feedback.struck_more: Struck! It sinks its head into the donkey again. %d more.
feedback.donkey_speared: The spear goes into the donkey! The spear-bearer crumbles to dust. Strike only while the snake's head is up.
feedback.donkey_eaten: The snake has eaten the donkey.
feedback.donkey_bitten: It bites the donkey. Strike it before it bites again: thrust as it lifts its head to the swishing tail.
feedback.controls: Press [space] to thrust the spear, while the snake's head is up off the donkey's back.

find.default: Look for the eater of the ass to your left.
find.nearby: Click the creature to take up the spear.
find.right: Look for the eater of the ass to your right.

fight.text: Watch the snake's head, not only the tail: thrust ([space]) only while its head is up off the donkey's back.

dangers.e41.instructions: Tie each band while the stirring is above it. Once all four are tied, strike the snake as it emerges.
dangers.e41.success: The snake is pinned on top of the bound sheaf.

feedback.snake_emerged: Bound tight, the sheaf forces the snake out on top.
feedback.band_tied: Tied. Below that band it has no room now.
feedback.band_broken: It was at that band: it bites through the stalks, and the band springs loose. Tie only once the stir has settled above it.
feedback.bitten: It struck first. Thrust ([space]) as soon as it comes out, before it strikes.

find.default: Look for the snake in the sheaf to your left.
find.nearby: Click the creature to take up the spear.
find.right: Look for the snake in the sheaf to your right.

bind.text: Wait for the stirring to settle above the next band, then [space].
